# Draft:Soviet Republic of Cerovec

The Soviet Republic of Cerovec (or Cerovec Council Republic) is a unrecognised micronation in Slovenia.
The Soviet Republic of Cerovec was established as micronation.
The Soviet Republic is unitary Marxist–Leninist one-party parliamentary socialist constitutional monarchy and is only (micronation) state with this type of government.
The Republic is registered as Klub dediščine Cerovčanov under registration number 2707942000 (Slovenia).
Head of State
The Head of State is known as:
* His Majesty The Sovereign of the Soviet Republic of Cerovec
